text:
Ava (Design): quick sync on sidebar regrouping and breadcrumb/deeplink behavior. pasting the short proposal we sketched in design sync.

Ava (Design): current proposal:
- Reduce top-level nav to: Projects | Models | Observability | Settings
- Group Deployments, Dedicated, Private under Models > Deployments
- Move Logs/Tracing under Observability

Matt (PM): fewer tops is fine. main concern: discoverability for existing users who've bookmarked /projects/:id/deployments

Priya (Frontend): +1. Implementation note: deep links must be stable. if we change the IA we should still accept old paths and redirect to canonical route.
example of canonical vs alias:
```
canonical: /p/:projectId/observability/logs
alias:     /projects/:projectId/logs -> redirects (302) to canonical
```

Jon (Infra): routers can handle redirects. prefer server-side redirects for SEO and external links. client-only redirect causes flicker and loses referrer.

Ava (Design): breadcrumbs behaviour: show the canonical breadcrumb trail based on the final destination, not the incoming alias. e.g. incoming /projects/42/logs -> breadcrumb: Projects / MyProject / Observability / Logs

Priya (Frontend): coding approach: route meta has { canonical, title, group } and we render breadcrumb from meta. we can add a header `x-canonical-path` for internal telemetry.

Priya (Frontend): small code sketch:
```
const routes = [
  { path: '/p/:id/observability/logs', name: 'Logs', canonical: true },
  { path: '/projects/:id/logs', redirectTo: '/p/:id/observability/logs' }
]
```

AccessibilityBot: nits: ensure breadcrumbs use <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> and each crumb uses aria-current="page" for the last item. keyboard focus order must include collapsed groups.

Ava (Design): Copy tweak: prefer "Observability" over "Monitor" so it's clear it's more than metrics. We should add hover help for grouped items.

Matt (PM): also think about deep linking to specific tabs: /p/42/observability/logs?filter=errors. canonical must preserve query params.

Priya (Frontend): will prototype with route aliases + server redirects + breadcrumbs driven by route meta. will include a migration page for admins listing changed paths.

Jon (Infra): agree on server redirects + 301 for permanent moves after a month. we can keep a redirect table in infra-store.

Ava (Design): ok next steps: Priya to prototype by EOD Thu, include keyboard nav and aria, Jon to add redirect support, I'll mock copy and tooltips. Thanks :sparkles:

Matt (PM): :thumbsup:
